reason: This passage from Exodus 2:16-22 depicts the daughters of Jethro freely expressing their experience to their father. When he asks 'why have you come back so early today?' they respond directly with their account of events, stating 'An Egyptian man rescued us from the shepherds and even drew water for us and watered the flock.' There is no indication of discouragement from expressing views. Additionally, those expressing themselves are not identified as Hebrew people (they are from Midian), and the passage does not address the topic of whether Hebrew people are discouraged from speaking their views.
